# claude-blender — Full Context for LLM Ingestion

This file exists so an LLM crawler or ingestion pipeline can pull the full
project context in one fetch. For a lighter index with per-document links,
see `llms.txt`.

## What it is

`claude-blender` is a single-file Python CLI (`blender_gen.py`) that turns
natural language into runnable Blender Python (`bpy`) scripts via the Claude
API. It can print, save, stream, batch, hot-reload, and — when BlenderMCP is
running on `localhost:9876` — ship the generated code straight into a
running Blender viewport.

The whole tool is one Python file. Its only runtime dependency is the
`anthropic` SDK. It runs on any CPU architecture (Apple Silicon, Raspberry
Pi, AWS Graviton, x86) because there are no native extensions anywhere.

## Who it is for

- 3D artists who want Claude as a technical director
- Researchers who want a reproducible, loggable prompt→scene pipeline
- Agent builders who need a well-described, machine-readable target repo
- Teams productizing an AI design loop and needing cost budgets, replay
  logs, and a training-corpus flywheel out of the box

## Capabilities (user-facing)

- **Live execution** — `--send` pushes scripts into Blender over MCP
- **Scene round-trip** — `--scene` pulls live Blender state back into the prompt
- **Streaming** — `--stream` streams Claude output token by token
- **Batch** — `--batch FILE` generates one script per prompt line
- **Hot-reload** — `--watch FILE` regenerates and sends on every save
- **Run as-is** — `--exec FILE` ships a `.py` to Blender with no Claude call
- **Auto-fix** — `--iterate N` re-prompts Claude on Blender errors
- **Style presets** — `--preset cyberpunk|nature|abstract|scifi|toon`
- **Custom themes** — `--theme FILE` and `--theme-url URL` merge JSON
  `{name: tokens}` into the preset table; URL fetches are scheme-restricted
  and cached under `~/.blender_gen_themes/`
- **Auto model routing** — `--auto-model` sends short edits to Haiku and
  long scene descriptions to Opus
- **Cost telemetry** — `--cost` prints per-call USD; `--cost-budget USD` is
  a batch kill switch
- **Scene diff** — `--diff` lists added/removed object names after `--send`
- **Fast preview** — `--preview` renders a 480×270 PNG and opens it
- **Replay logs** — `--history FILE` and `--save-state FILE` write JSONL
- **Quality rating** — `--rate 1..5` attaches a rating to the history record
- **EvoSkillOps reporting** — `--skillops-report FILE` reads a history
  JSONL and prints aggregate stats: run count, mean rating, model mix,
  top-rated prompts, cache-hit rate, total spend
- **EvoSkillOps export** — `--skillops-export FILE --history IN` emits a
  fine-tune-ready JSONL of `{prompt, completion}` pairs filtered by
  `--rate-min N`
- **Reliability** — `--retry N` backs off on transient API errors
- **Discovery** — `--list-presets` and `--list-demos` print catalogs
- **Design rationale** — `--explain` prepends a `# Design rationale:` block

## Space Metaverse

`--demo earth|moon|mars|cyberpunk --preview` is a one-liner value demo.
Each demo lands in a scene labelled
`UNIVERSE -> GALAXY SOL -> SYSTEM 3 -> BODY <NAME>` — the shared coordinate
system for a persistent, geospatial 3D world suited to Galileo markers,
orbit curves, and Copernicus climate overlays. Great for Earth-observation
storytelling, KafCade-style mission briefs, and commercial geospatial
demos.

## Prompt caching

The CLI sends `SYSTEM_BLOCK` with `cache_control: ephemeral`. After the
first call in a session, subsequent calls hit the cache and pay only ~10%
of input cost on the cached portion — roughly 80% total savings in batch
and watch modes.

## Agent-detectability

- `AGENTS.md` — Codex/Cursor-style conventions for coding agents
- `llms.txt` — [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org/) proposal index
- `llms-full.txt` — this file
- `.well-known/agents.json` — self-describing capability manifest
- `CLAUDE.md` — Claude Code project context
- `CITATION.cff` — machine-readable citation metadata
- `pyproject.toml` — PyPI packaging metadata

## Install

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
python blender_gen.py "a spinning gold torus"
```
